name: hugo-twitter-style
description: A Hugo theme that renders posts like an X/Twitter profile timeline.

scripts.test: sh -c 'cmd="hugo server --source exampleSite --themesDir ../.. --theme hugo-twitter-style --buildDrafts --disableFastRender --noBuildLock --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 1313"; if command -v hugo >/dev/null 2>&1; then eval "$cmd"; else nix-shell -p hugo --run "$cmd"; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c 'cmd="hugo --source exampleSite --themesDir ../.. --theme hugo-twitter-style --destination ../public --noBuildLock"; if command -v hugo >/dev/null 2>&1; then eval "$cmd"; else nix-shell -p hugo --run "$cmd"; fi'

author: Kyure_A
